key.name: shortcut
key.description: Accelerator that opens a terminal in the focused terminal's directory.

key.name: default-terminal
key.description: Command used when the focused window is not a terminal. Empty means the system default terminal (org.gnome.desktop.default-applications.terminal).

key.name: fallback-directory
key.description: Directory used when no terminal is focused or its directory cannot be determined. Empty means the home directory.
